verdict.rationale: Radar's own docs show custom rules built in the Dashboard from supported attributes, value lists that rules can reference, and outcomes covering block, review and allow (trusted-customer lists, Allow Rules). The evidence does not show that rules can reference model risk scores or velocity counters, and community reports say Allow Rules must be enabled by support for newer businesses. Missing for 10: documented use of model risk scores in rule conditions, documented velocity/counter attributes, self-serve Allow Rules, independent hands-on corroboration of combined-condition rules.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can author custom rules that combine model scores, velocity counters, list matches, and transaction attributes into allow, block, or review decisions
